message: No runtime checks have run yet (0 checks, status blocked), so this design hasn't been validated. The empty failures list doesn't mean anything passed. The first blocker is the Event Hubs telemetry collection. None of the typed generator contracts covers Event Hubs, Functions, Data Explorer, Container Apps, Azure OpenAI or Entra. The only Azure contract is private object storage, and switching to it would shrink our incident explainer down to storage, so I'm not proposing any graph change. Each of these components needs a native Azure implementation in the product before local emulation can test anything. The first useful reproducer is your synthetic incident fixture: planted secrets, an injected instruction, a missing span and a duplicate batch. Even after those checks pass, the mocked model only shows that the safeguards and plumbing work. It won't tell us whether the reasoning is any good. That needs a separate evaluation against a real Azure OpenAI deployment, and we haven't confirmed one exists. Before we pick a region and size the implementation work, one thing would help most: which country must this log and trace data stay in?
